[[File:TheOtherSagaBegins-TDC.jpg|right|thumb|Turazza carry boxes of power capacitors]]
A '''power capacitor''' was a piece of equipment that certain systems, such as [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], needed to function. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keleman Ciro]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] needed fifty turbolaser power capacitors for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''. Although he and his crew looked around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], they were unable to find them. When prospective crewbeing [[Loh'khar]] appeared with his [[Turazza]] minions and fifty new capacitors, Ciro accepted them in the crew.
